tip_tc:
CLIPS  (Premiere-style timecode)

Format:   HH:MM:SS:FF   = hours : minutes : seconds : frames
Example:  00:01:23:15   = 1 minute, 23 seconds and 15 frames

The last number counts FRAMES inside that second (0 up to fps-1),
so you can cut to the exact frame. At 30 fps the frames go 00-29,
at 60 fps they go 00-59.

Start = first frame you want.
End   = last frame you want (this frame is included).
Leave End empty to go until the end of the video.
If you add no clips, the whole video is downloaded.

Typing shortcut (like Premiere): numbers fill from the right.
    1523  ->  00:00:15:23        100  ->  00:00:01:00

From the end: start with a minus sign.
    Start  -00:00:00:15   (End empty) = the LAST 15 FRAMES
    Start  -00:00:01:00   (End empty) = the last second

Use semicolons (00;01;23;15) for drop-frame timecode (29.97 / 59.94 fps).

Clips are cut AFTER the download using the video's real frame rate,
so they are frame-accurate. They are re-encoded to the chosen format.
h_mp4: Works in Premiere Pro and almost everything. Up to 1080p.
h_movh: Same quality as MP4 in a MOV container, no re-encoding. Up to 1080p.
h_movp: For smooth editing. Very large files (about 100 GB per hour at 1080p30). Up to 4K.
h_webm: VP9 + Opus exactly as YouTube serves them. Up to 4K. Premiere may not open it.
h_mkv: Flexible container. Up to 4K. Premiere may not open it.
h_wav: Uncompressed, great for editing. Large files.
sc_url_ph: Link to a channel, playlist or profile
sc_tabs_hint: A playlist link, Twitch, etc. also work.
sc_approx_note: Approximate date: the quick list from YouTube does not always give the exact date; it is checked when downloading.
sc_task: Check even when videoprep is closed (Windows scheduled task)
sc_firstrun_new: Only download what is new from now on
sc_firstrun_backfill: Also download older videos that pass the filters
sc_subs_note: Each subscription keeps its own history: nothing is downloaded twice. New videos are downloaded to the subscription folder automatically, with pauses between requests so YouTube is not overloaded.
sc_warn_account: Many requests while logged in can put your account at risk. For public channels, prefer no cookies or a secondary account. videoprep spaces out its requests but cannot guarantee anything.
sc_legal: Use this feature only with content you own, have licensed or have permission to use. videoprep is not affiliated with YouTube, Google, Twitch, Kick, X, Meta or TikTok.
sc_blocked: YouTube asked for verification: the check was stopped.
sc_list_error: This link could not be listed. It may be private, need a login, or not be supported.
txt_cookie_export: To avoid reading the browser on every request, videoprep keeps a copy of the cookies in your user folder while it is open and deletes it when it closes.
prev_timeout: The preview took too long. Retrying without cookies.
msg_vfr: This video has a variable frame rate: cuts may not be frame-accurate.
